segments.comment: A debug-mode human Valkyrie maps the level with ^F so that walking raises no notices. She creates a hostile jackal, wishes a fountain onto her own square and steps away from the jackal, which follows onto the fountain; she names it with a 57-character name and slays it with #wizkill. wizcmds.c wiz_kill() prints "You kill <name>!", which nearly fills the top line, and calls mon.c xkilled(): mondead()'s m_detach() redraws the square, xkilled()'s own newsym() (3642) draws the fountain again while its gbuf entry is still new, and display.c show_glyph() (2011-2068) announces "(southeast): fountain." through pline_xy(). The line does not fit, so it waits at --More-- after vpline()'s flush_screen() has run bot() (display.c 2236-2239): the status rows there are the ones from before xkilled() reaches more_experienced() (3672-3674). With time and showexp the --More-- shows Xp:1/0 and the next line Xp:1/1. Seed, clock, character and inputs were chosen for this path, independently of every recorded session.
